other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered female member or the wife of a registered male member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
Female beneficiaries may receive the benefit up to two times in their lifetime
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per maternity, payable up to two times in a beneficiary's lifetime.
